about: MOH-editable household container catalog. To add a container: append a row with a unique id, volumeMl, per-locale labels, an iconPath, a treatment kind, a phrase-bank slug (add the matching slug to i18n/phrase_bank.json), and, when the volume needs a special mixing picture, an orsMeasurementVisualAssetId. No IR or code change required. Updates are checksum-gated (see CONTRACTS.md Section: Config).
